toolbox.title: Godot Toolbox & Typography
toolbox.subtitle: DynamicFont / FontFile injection, PCK unpacker, and clean vanilla revert
toolbox.font_card_desc: Inject custom TTF/OTF fonts into Godot theme or diagnose missing character glyphs to avoid empty boxes (□).
toolbox.pck_unpacker_desc: Unpack standalone .pck or embedded executable packages directly to disk preserving Godot res:// hierarchy.
toolbox.revert_card_desc: Removes override.cfg, patch.pck, and bootstrap scripts to restore the untouched original game.
toolbox.cache_card_desc: Manage cached translations and application logs.
toolbox.extract_no_game: Please select a Godot game first.
toolbox.revert_success: Restored vanilla state: removed {count} patch files.

settings.title: Settings & AI Configuration
settings.subtitle: UI language, translation engines, API keys, and cache management
settings.appearance_desc: Customize the application theme, brightness mode, and accent color palette.
settings.ui_language_desc: Select the language used for the GodotLocalizer interface. Applied instantly.
settings.backup_desc: The game's own files are never modified; the patch is added as separate files. 'Remove patch' in the Toolbox deletes them and restores the original state.
settings.engine_select_desc: All translations route through your selected engine. Google Translate and Bing require no API key.
settings.json_keys_card_desc: Extra key names that hold player-facing text in the game's own JSON files (comma separated).
settings.pck_dialog_missing: The game package is protected with a Godot encryption key. Enter the 64-character hexadecimal key so it can be read.
settings.pck_dialog_wrong: That key did not decrypt this package. Check it and try again.
settings.pck_dialog_invalid: The key must be 64 hexadecimal characters (0-9, a-f).
settings.json_dialog_title: Text found in the game's data files
settings.json_dialog_hint: The recommended choices are already ticked; most of the time you can simply continue. For anything I am unsure about, each row says what I think it is and shows an example from the game.
settings.legacy_dialog_title: Scripts in an older compiled format were found
settings.legacy_dialog_body: {count} scripts use an older Godot bytecode format. Reading their text needs GDRE Tools. You will see the file name, size and checksum before anything is downloaded.
settings.gdre_dialog_hint: Nothing is downloaded without your approval. The file comes only from the official GitHub repository, is verified against its SHA-256 and is unpacked into the app's own data folder.
settings.gdre_card_desc: Compiled scripts (.gdc) from Godot 4.3 and later are read directly. GDRE Tools is only needed for scripts compiled in the older format (4.0–4.2); the app asks during translation if that is the case. Before any download you see the file name, size and checksum and must confirm.
settings.pck_key_card_desc: Games exported with a Godot script encryption key need that key to be read. It is stored only on this computer.
settings.batch_size_hint: Lines sent to machine-translation engines at once (recommended: 100). Bing accepts at most 100. AI engines have their own batch setting: "Batch size — AI engines" in the Engines & AI tab.
settings.rtl_shaping_checkbox: Static letter joining and direction fix for right-to-left languages (Arabic, Persian, Hebrew)
settings.rtl_shaping_desc: Godot 3 does not join Arabic letters or reorder right-to-left text. When enabled, translations are written to the patch in visual order; tags and placeholders such as %s or {name} are preserved. Godot 4 shapes this text itself, so the option only affects Godot 3 games.
settings.patch_options_hint: Source language, target language and translation engine are chosen in the Dashboard's Quick Settings.
settings.active_engine_hint: Change it in Dashboard › Quick Settings
settings.deepl_key_label: DeepL API Key (Free keys end with ':fx'):
settings.cache_desc: Previously translated strings and manual fixes from the Review Editor are stored here, so repeated runs finish instantly.
settings.cache_clear_confirm: All cached translations and manual fixes will be deleted. The next run translates everything again.
settings.glossary_desc: Applied to every translation automatically: a word in the engine's output (whole-word, case-insensitive match) is replaced with your preferred term. Use it to keep character names, places and game terms consistent.
settings.show_debug_engines_desc: Test the game UI before translating: text is rewritten with accented letters and padded by 30%, so overflowing buttons and missing glyphs show up in game. Not for real patches.
settings.openai_base_url_hint: For OpenAI-compatible services such as OpenRouter, Together or Groq. Leave empty for official OpenAI.
settings.ai_card_desc: Applies to Gemini, OpenAI, DeepSeek and local LLM engines.
settings.ai_temperature_hint: Low values give consistent, literal translations; higher values a freer style. 0.2–0.4 is recommended for games.
settings.ai_prompt_placeholder: e.g. A dark fantasy game. Characters address each other informally; do not translate spell names.
settings.ai_prompt_hint: Appended after the built-in rules (placeholders, tags); it can never override them.
settings.batch_size_title: Batch size — Google, Bing, DeepL, LibreTranslate
settings.network_card_desc: Applies to Google, Bing, DeepL and LibreTranslate. Defaults are tuned for maximum speed without IP bans.
settings.concurrency_hint: Without proxies at most 4 are used for safety; a proxy list lifts this cap.
settings.multi_endpoint_desc: Spreads load across 13 Google domains; when off only translate.googleapis.com is used.
settings.lingva_desc: Tries third-party Lingva servers as a last resort when every Google route is blocked.
settings.aggressive_retry_checkbox: Get a second opinion for lines returned untranslated
settings.aggressive_retry_desc: Re-asks a different Google endpoint family for lines echoed back unchanged. Slower, but reduces untranslated lines.
settings.proxy_card_desc: The most effective answer to Google's per-IP throttling. Requests rotate across proxies; a proxy that keeps failing is benched for 5 minutes.
settings.proxy_list_hint: One proxy per line. http:// is assumed when no scheme is given; socks5:// needs PySocks. Lines starting with # are ignored.
settings.use_cache_desc: When off, every run sends all strings to the engine again (e.g. to try a different engine).
settings.protected_card_desc: Character, place and brand names are never sent to the engine and are kept verbatim. If a term goes missing the line goes to the Review Editor. Case-sensitive, whole-word match.
settings.protected_terms_placeholder:
One term per line, e.g.:
Aria
Night City
settings.tm_card_desc: Reuses existing human translations before any engine: TMX, CSV/TSV or JSON files. Matching lines never reach the engine.
settings.tm_files_hint: One file path per line. If a source appears in several files, the later file wins.
settings.tm_fuzzy_desc: Also uses very similar lines; only matches with exactly the same placeholders and tags are accepted.
settings.ai_batch_hint: Lines per request for Gemini, OpenAI, DeepSeek and local LLMs (recommended: 15). With large prompts models skip lines or break the XML.
settings.bilingual_card_desc: Shows the original text next to the translation (for language learners and for reviewing).
settings.bilingual_switch: Append the original text below the translation
settings.bilingual_switch_desc: Strings with format specifiers like %d, variables like {name} or tags like [color] stay single-language so they cannot break. Text gets longer, so some buttons may overflow.
settings.bilingual_template_hint: {target} is replaced by the translation, {source} by the original. Type \n for a line break. Left empty, the default (translation, original on the next line) is used.
settings.advanced_card_desc: The key of an encrypted game, extra JSON fields and GDRE Tools are asked for automatically while translating, when needed. Open this to change or clear a saved value.
settings.json_reason_prose: Made of sentences; looks like text shown in the game. I recommend adding it.
settings.json_reason_maybe: Short phrases; I am not sure they are shown in the game. Look at the example and decide.
settings.json_reason_table_source: Looks like the original-language (English) column of the game's own translation table. I recommend translating it.
settings.json_reason_table_translated: The other column of the same table: looks like a translation the game already has. I recommend leaving it out.
settings.json_reason_table_unclear: Two columns side by side (probably the game's translation table) but I cannot tell which one is the original language. Check the example and tick the original-language one.

errors.custom_signature: “{file}” cannot be translated. Its data package starts with the signature “{signature}” instead of the standard “GDPC”: the developer exported the game with a custom Godot build, usually together with encryption, and GodotLocalizer cannot read such packages. Nothing was changed in the game folder.
errors.no_game_package: No Godot game package was found in “{folder}”. Select the game's .pck file, or the .exe / .x86_64 file that contains it. Nothing was changed.
